methodology: Append-only Realty observation history. Historical snapshot files are immutable evidence; the current snapshot remains separate and is joined at read time. A chart/trend must not be inferred from insufficient independent observations.
archiveRule: Before a future current market snapshot is materially replaced, preserve the outgoing observation as an append-only history artifact when it represents an independent source observation worth retaining.

chartPolicy.twoPointBehavior: Show exact previous-to-current change cards; do not render a trend line.
